text:
alex: Heads up — spotted a pretty big spot price spike in us-west1 GPU pool ~15m ago, some preemptible tasks are getting evicted. Anyone else seeing this? @maya @vikram

maya: Seeing the same. Eviction_count up ~300% last 10m, autoscaler started flapping. A few jobs failed healthchecks and restarted.

vikram: We should run the fallback to dedicated burst. Do we have spare capacity in west1? @lisa-procurement can you check immediate allocation for A100s? Also thinking we should flip a small canary first.

lisa-procurement: I can allocate a short buffer — we have ~10 A100s in our reserved pool in west1 that are idle. Need approval to attach to the Dedicated burst project. Estimated incremental cost ~ $2.5k/day if left running.

jordan: If we failover, update routing to prefer the dedicated pool and add fallback variant. Quick curl to set route (example):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.internal/v1/routes/update \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"route":"llm-generation","primary":"ephemeral-west1","fallback":"dedicated-burst-west1","canary":0.05}'
```

alex: Plan: 1) Allocate 10 A100s temporarily (if approved). 2) Start 5% canary for 10m, monitor latency/error. 3) If stable, ramp to 100% over 5m. Also warm KV cache on dedicated nodes before routing.

sre-bot: ALERT: Autoscaler group 'ephemeral-gpu-west1' scaled from 6 -> 0 at 12:34 UTC due to Spot evictions.

vikram: Action items: @lisa confirm allocation & open ticket; @maya run canary & post latency; @jordan prepare rollback; I'll coordinate cutover and open incident if SLA is impacted.

lisa-procurement: Approved for 10 A100s for 6 hours to mitigate. Ticket PROC-4527 created. :thumbsup:

maya: Canary started (5% traffic). Initial numbers: p50 +30ms, p95 +120ms, error rate unchanged. Will report again at +10m.

alex: Thanks all. If we need a manual rollback: run `redwoodctl route set llm-generation --primary ephemeral-west1 --fallback dedicated-burst-west1` and then `redwoodctl cache warm --model /models/xxx`. Ping #oncall if anything spikes.

jordan: I'll prep a short rollback doc and post link in this thread.

alex: Good. Keep this thread updated and drop postmortem notes under incidents/ if we escalate.
